text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While training for the Japanese Derby, 
Matikanetannhauser heard from Rice Shower 
about her deep admiration for Mihono 
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, several reporters visited the 
Academy to interview Mihono Bourbon. Among 
them was a round-glasses reporter looking 
noticeably downcast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To reporters claiming "no one reads 
articles about anyone but Bourbon," who 
expect no other future than Bourbon's 
victory, Matikanetannhauser speaks her 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Sure, there's nothing special about me— 
but even so, I won't settle for anything 
less than first place!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her impassioned words conveyed her 
heartfelt feelings... and seemed to strike 
a chord with the round-glasses reporter, 
who appeared to be troubled by something.
